tool.name: samtools_fixmate
tool.description: Samtools fixmate is a tool that can fill in information (insert size, cigar, mapq) about paired end reads onto the corresponding other read. Also has options to remove secondary/unmapped alignments and recalculate whether reads are proper pairs.

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use

tool.help:
**samtools_fixmate**
Samtools fixmate is a tool that can fill in information (insert size, cigar, mapq) about paired end reads onto the corresponding other read. Also has options to remove secondary/unmapped alignments and recalculate whether reads are proper pairs.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: samtools/fixmate - Container: biocontainers/samtools:1.22.1--h96c455f_0
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
